name: EntityIndex
meaning: Row number of the entity in the BOS Entities table; -1 when a row is about no entity.

name: LocalId
meaning: The id the source file gave the entity (the STEP id of an IFC file, the element id of Revit).

name: StepId
meaning: The EntityText view's name for LocalId.

name: GlobalId
meaning: The entity's globally unique id (an IfcGloballyUniqueId); empty when the source gave none.

name: Name
meaning: The entity's name, or a parameter's name in a parameter table.

name: Category
meaning: The entity's category: the IFC class (IFCWALL) or the Revit category.

name: CategoryType
meaning: The kind of the category, as the source file classifies it.

name: Type
meaning: The name of the entity's type (the family type of an element), or the type of a BCF issue.

name: ClassName
meaning: The class of the entity in the source model.

name: Level
meaning: Name of the level or storey the entity sits on.

name: Elevation
meaning: Height of the level or element; absent when the model gives none.

name: Room
meaning: Name of the room the entity is in, or a room's label in a hop table.

name: Document
meaning: Title of the document (the linked or host model) the entity comes from.

name: Workset
meaning: Id of the workset the entity belongs to; absent when it has none.

name: Group
meaning: Name of the group the entity belongs to.

name: MinX
meaning: Smallest X of the element's bounding box.

name: MinY
meaning: Smallest Y of the element's bounding box.

name: MinZ
meaning: Smallest Z of the element's bounding box.

name: MaxX
meaning: Largest X of the element's bounding box.

name: MaxY
meaning: Largest Y of the element's bounding box.

name: MaxZ
meaning: Largest Z of the element's bounding box.

name: SizeX
meaning: Extent of the bounding box along X (MaxX - MinX).

name: SizeY
meaning: Extent of the bounding box along Y (MaxY - MinY).

name: SizeZ
meaning: Extent of the bounding box along Z (MaxZ - MinZ).

name: CenterX
meaning: X of the bounding box's center.

name: CenterY
meaning: Y of the bounding box's center.

name: CenterZ
meaning: Z of the bounding box's center.

name: FootprintArea
meaning: Area of the bounding box seen from above (SizeX * SizeY), not of the element's true footprint.

name: Volume
meaning: A volume: of the bounding box in bim.bounds (SizeX * SizeY * SizeZ), of the room in bim.rooms.

name: Diagonal
meaning: Length of the bounding box's space diagonal.

name: Number
meaning: The room's number as a label (text, because numbers like 'A-101' occur).

name: UnboundedHeight
meaning: The room's unbounded height parameter; absent when the room has none.

name: ElementCount
meaning: How many elements a level or room holds.

name: RoomCount
meaning: How many rooms a level holds.

name: Discipline
meaning: The discipline an element is assigned to (architectural, structural, mechanical, ...).

name: RoomClass
meaning: The class bim.classifyRooms gave the room from its name.

name: Door
meaning: EntityIndex of a door.

name: DoorName
meaning: The door's name.

name: FromRoom
meaning: Label of the room on the door's from side; 'Outside' when there is none.

name: ToRoom
meaning: Label of the room on the door's to side; 'Outside' when there is none.

name: Hops
meaning: Doors to pass from the start room; absent when the room cannot be reached.

name: Distance
meaning: A distance in the model's length unit: to the nearest candidate row in bim.nearest, from the plan centre in bim.orientation.

name: ParameterGroup
meaning: The group a parameter is filed under in the source tool's property dialog.

name: ValueType
meaning: The kind of a parameter's value: String, Number, Entity, Point and so on.

name: Units
meaning: The unit name the source file gave a parameter; absent when it gave none.

name: Value
meaning: A parameter's value as text, whatever its ValueType (the ParameterText view). The lowercase value column of chart, scale and colour tables is a number and is not this kind.

name: Count
meaning: How many rows or entities fall in the group.

name: Distinct
meaning: How many different values a parameter takes.

name: FillRate
meaning: Share of entities that carry the parameter, from 0 to 1.

name: EntityIndexA
meaning: EntityIndex of the first entity of a relation.

name: EntityIndexB
meaning: EntityIndex of the second entity of a relation; for containment, the container.

name: NameA
meaning: Name of the first entity of a relation.

name: NameB
meaning: Name of the second entity of a relation.

name: RelationType
meaning: The kind of a relation: PartOf, MemberOf, ContainedIn and so on.

name: StoreyIndex
meaning: EntityIndex of the building storey above an entity.

name: StoreyName
meaning: Name of the building storey above an entity.

name: Depth
meaning: Relations between an entity and its storey; 0 for the storey itself.

name: Title
meaning: The issue's title; rows with one title form one issue (one BCF topic).

name: Description
meaning: What is wrong, in words.

name: Status
meaning: The issue's state, for example Open or Closed.

name: Priority
meaning: The issue's priority, for example High.

name: CheckId
meaning: Identifier of the check or specification that produced the verdict.

name: Verdict
meaning: The result of a check on an entity: Pass, Fail, or InfoNotAvailable when the model lacks what the check reads.

name: CheckTitle
meaning: Human title of the check, shown to people.

name: Citation
meaning: The requirement the check enforces, as its source states it (a code clause, the IDS facets).

name: Reason
meaning: Why the entity got its verdict.

name: TopicGuid
meaning: The BCF topic's guid.

name: Author
meaning: Who created the BCF topic.

name: CreationDate
meaning: When the BCF topic was created, as UTC ISO text (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ); empty when the file gives none.

name: AuthoringToolId
meaning: An id the authoring tool gave the entity (a Revit UniqueId), set when a BCF names a component only by it; GlobalId is then empty.

name: Elements
meaning: How many elements a BCF topic selects.

name: GlobalIds
meaning: The GlobalIds of a BCF topic's elements, comma-separated.

name: Bearing
meaning: Degrees clockwise from project north (+Y of the model) to the element's box centre as seen from the plan centre; absent at the centre. BOS records no true-north angle.

name: Sector
meaning: The 45-degree compass slice of the bearing, 0 (N) to 7 (NW), clockwise.

name: Direction
meaning: The compass point of the bearing's slice: N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W or NW.

name: Facing
meaning: The side (N, E, S or W) the box's larger vertical face looks out to.

name: FacingArea
meaning: Area of the box's larger vertical face, max(SizeX, SizeY) * SizeZ; it overstates a diagonal element's face.

name: Task
meaning: One trade's work on one storey, named 'Storey - Trade'.

name: Storey
meaning: Name of the storey a scheduled task works.

name: Trade
meaning: The trade that does a task: Structure, Envelope, MEP, Finishes, or the names the node was given.

name: Start
meaning: First day of a task, as an ISO date (yyyy-MM-dd).

name: End
meaning: Day after a task's last day (exclusive), as an ISO date (yyyy-MM-dd).

name: DurationDays
meaning: Calendar days a task lasts.

name: Finish
meaning: The End of the task an element is installed in, as an ISO date.

name: FinishWeek
meaning: The week, counted from 1 at the schedule's start, that holds the task's last working day (End - 1).

name: Synthetic
meaning: True when the value comes from a generated schedule, not from the model: an invented plan, not a recorded one.

name: IfcVersion
meaning: The IFC schema versions a specification applies to, comma-separated.

name: Cardinality
meaning: Whether a specification's applicable entities are required, optional or prohibited.

name: Applicability
meaning: The facets that select the entities a specification applies to, in short form.

name: Requirements
meaning: The facets an applicable entity must satisfy, in short form.

name: Supported
meaning: False when a facet of the specification would give InfoNotAvailable because BOS cannot answer it.

name: Pass
meaning: How many rows of a check got the verdict Pass.

name: Fail
meaning: How many rows of a check got the verdict Fail.

name: InfoNotAvailable
meaning: How many rows of a check got the verdict InfoNotAvailable.

name: Rows
meaning: How many verdict rows a check produced.
